parole.significato: -gen (a producer of something, or an agent in the production of something)

parole.significato: A distinguishable foreign word-ending in nouns. It is not considered an independent suffix in Hungarian.
parole.testo: Ultimately from French -age (noun-forming suffix). It occurs in Hungarian in borrowings directly from French, or sourced from French but entering Hungarian via German or another language.

parole.significato: a delicate, unpleasant, or embarrassing affair

parole.significato: argot, jargon, slang, cant (a secret language or conventional slang peculiar to thieves, tramps and vagabonds)

parole.significato: assassin (someone who intentionally kills a person, especially a professional who kills a public or political figure)

parole.significato: to desert (to leave a military or naval unit without permission)

parole.significato: diplomatic (concerning the relationships between the governments of countries)

parole.significato: dome, cupola (a structural element resembling the hollow upper half of a sphere)

parole.significato: slab serif (of a typeface, characterized by linear strokes and thick, block-like serifs)

parole.significato: palette (a thin board on which a painter lays and mixes colours)
